card.title: Chain of Command
card.instruction: Treat every question, favor, and decision as something that must travel through the proper hierarchy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I lend you this ladder, your department head must ask mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're neighbours, cleaning gutters. My wife sent me over.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then her request should go to my wife. I can supply the ladder's dimensions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your wife's away. She left you in charge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then address it to me as acting head. I'll forward it to her for confirmation.
